column5: READ LIVE 2026-09-21 with get_metadata as its OWN node - the read the row has been carried without since wave 55 - and it OVERTURNS the carried note, which said one re-read closed it with no code change. The note was scoped to the tile row and never looked at the footer, which is a CHILD of this frame and carries two money readouts. THE GEOMETRY, all of it confirmed to the decimal against the code: the frame is 954 x 621; the tile row Frame 1000004028 9204:17382 is 595.1658325 x 112.6331711 at (181, 217.1834); its five tiles sit at x = 0 / 120.63317 / 241.26634 / 361.89951 / 482.53268, each 112.6331711 square, so the gap is exactly 8 and 5 x 112.63317 + 4 x 8 = 595.16585, the row's own width; each tile carries a `Heads` face 80.1948 square at a 16.2192 inset (16.2192 x 2 + 80.1948 = 112.63316, centred) and a single-digit ordinal 9 x 18 at (96, 4.8164); NO tile carries a side chip, because nothing has been called yet. CoinflipBoard.tsx:745 caps the grid at lg:max-w-[595.1658px] on repeat(cols, minmax(0,1fr)), and coinflipTheme.ts:92-110 derives every tile figure from the same 112.6332 divisor - gap 8, art 80.1948, chip 15, ordinal 14 - so the tile, pitch, face and inset are the frame's own numbers, not a fit. The ordinal insets match the node exactly: pl-[6.2148%] = 7/112.6332, pr-[6.777%] = 7.63317/112.6332 (its 9-wide box ends at 105 of 112.6332) and top 4.2761% = 4.8164/112.6332 for the armed row, against 6.0518% for the settled twin 9204:17690. Footer Frame 1000003871 9204:17454 is 884 x 90 at (35, 511), symmetric in the 954 (35 + 884 + 35 = 954), two 425 x 66 cards at x=12 and x=447 each with a 42-tall card 24 below a 16 label - which is what CoinflipBoard.tsx:431-445 already documents and draws. THE ONE ITEM THE ROW CARRIED, now measured rather than asserted: the row's x is 181 and 954 - 181 - 595.1658 = 177.834, so the row is 1.583 LEFT of centre on the board. 5 x 112 + 4 x 8 = 592 and (954 - 592) / 2 = 181 exactly, so the row was authored centred at a 592 width and the 3.1658 it later grew went right without a recentre; the footer in the same frame is perfectly symmetric, which is the designer's own evidence that the board centres. The code centres the 595.1658 grid in a fluid column, landing at 179.417. Reproducing 181 would mean hardcoding a 1.583 left bias into a responsive board - the frame's technique, not its result - so it stays centred and the deviation is named here instead. WHAT KEEPS IT PARTIAL IS THE FOOTER'S FIGURES, and it is a money finding, not a layout gap: the board draws Multiplier 31.3600 (text 9204:17464) and Win Chance 3.13 (text 9204:17479), which are the five-coin all-match parlay's numbers (0.98 / 0.03125 = 31.36, 1/32 = 3.13%) carried over from the Target board that shares this 884 x 90 strip (9190:15502). This frame is CLASSIC Auto - five independent single calls - and the rail pays coinMultiplier(currency), 1.90 on POINTS and 1.95 on chain, at a 50.0000 win chance. CoinFlipGame.tsx:1414-1424 prints the rail's figure and not the board's, which is correct and stays: a board is a picture of a number, never the number. NO CODE CHANGE THIS PASS - decision D1 puts coinflip's odds, multiplier, edge and EV out of bounds for this lane, and the layout was already the frame's. CASEY CALL to close the row: (a) accept the rail's 1.9500 / 50.0000 under the board's labels and count the frame done on layout, (b) have the board's 31.3600 / 3.13 corrected in Figma to the classic rail's figures, or (c) rule the strip a frame-defect on this cut for carrying the Target board's numbers.

The standing DEFECT-SCOPE note stands and was not re-derived: the frame is filed as 'Skai > Play > Casino > Hi-Lo Start (1440 x 900px)' and is neither Hi-Lo nor 900 tall, which DartsPage.tsx:13-20 already documents. WHAT WAS READ LIVE 2026-09-21 with get_metadata is its difficulty track 9392:1906, re-read as its own node to test the carried claim that the track is 38 and not 42 - a LEAD, not a finding, because it overturns a number this lane shipped from 2026-08-31. IT HOLDS, exactly: 9392:1906 is 324 x 38 at (0,24) holding three cells 103 / 102 / 103 at x = 4 / 111 / 217, each 30 tall at y=4 with an 18-tall label at y=6, so 4 + 103 + 4 + 102 + 4 + 103 + 4 = 324 and 4 + 30 + 4 = 38 both close exactly. DartsGame.tsx:1729 and :1748 already drew that 38/30 at HEAD, so the transcription needed no change and the row's geometry is settled. WHAT THIS PASS FIXED IS THAT THE 30 WAS NOT REACHING THE SCREEN. src/index.css:773-780 floors button:not(.no-min-size) to min-height 44px inside @media (max-width: 768px); min-height is a different property from height, so a cell declaring 30 rendered 44 and the active blue segment bled 3 out of each end of a track fixed at 38. The same panel's Manual / Auto tabs were worse and were invisible to the existing sweep: they take h-full inside a 42 track with p-1, i.e. 34, and flooredSourceControls reports only tags that DECLARE a height under the floor, never ones that declare none - its own docblock says so - so 34 floored to 44 pushed 5 out of each end of that track with no oracle able to see it. Both are opted out at the CALL SITE per Casey's 2026-09-07 ruling (match the frames, opt out with no-min-size), never by editing the floor, and the finger's 44 is bought back with the overlay pattern PlaySectionHeader established: 30 + 2x7 and 34 + 2x5, on the y axis only, because the cells are already 103 and 158 wide and an x inset would reach across the 4px gap into the neighbouring segment and steal its clicks. SWEPT FOR THE SHAPE RATHER THAN FIXING THE FILE THAT WAS NAMED: flooredSourceControls over all four owned directories reports 83 controls declaring a height under the floor across 27 files, and that is a LANE-WIDE finding for the orchestrator, not this row - the two fixed here are the two with frame numbers behind them (9392:1906 at 1440 and 9455:19100 at 375, which draws the identical track at 343 x 38 with three 109 x 30 cells). NEW ORACLE dartsTouchFloor.test.ts, 6 green: it guards both boards' arithmetic before measuring anything against them, reads the floor rule off src/index.css rather than restating it (the cause lives in a file this suite does not otherwise render), names the two controls the sweep cannot see, and PINS THE REMAINING HIT SET to the one known floored control - the auto-play Rounds quick-picks at h-6 - so a newly added floored control fails rather than joining it unnoticed. Those Rounds chips are deliberately NOT opted out: no board this lane has read draws that row, so their 24 is the component's own and whether to keep it is a design question, not a transcription. Negative control asserts the 52h CTA does NOT carry the token, so the fix is not a blanket. WHY THE ROW STAYS PARTIAL and it is not layout: Ruling 15 and Ruling 19 - Darts gets three paytables, the ladders are a consensus change needing a height gate and lab re-certification, and never draw a paytable the engine does not pay. Nothing on the odds, RTP or paytable path was touched. The 1440 cut itself was already drawing the track correctly and is unchanged by this commit; the repair lands at the 375 and 768 boards, where the same component draws and the floor was live. Neighbouring suites re-run green after the change: dartsPanelRadius, dartsThrowColumn, dartsBoardGeometry, dartsRailOrderAndType and fairnessSubBar375, 111 tests. Scoped tsc over both touched files reports 0 errors, proved in-program with --listFiles (2 of 2). Commit skai-gaming 67a4e220, on main, not pushed - Ruling 16; done here would mean landed, not live.
